requested_outcome: Route approved vacation filter combinations to complete clean indexable pages instead of leaving technical query parameters, beginning with נופש בצפון עם בריכה.
natural_destination: VII vacation filters, clean managed search pages and the search-pages sitemap.
authorization_boundary: Local code, content and tests only. Public deployment, database changes, supplier data, secrets, bindings, schedules, DNS and domains are outside this turn.

lesson_bundle.reason: The reported defect belongs to a shared route family and a one URL repair would not prove the product outcome.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require exact destination evidence for no-type, type-specific, transactional and sitemap paths.

lesson_bundle.reason: A visible filter promises a navigation result whose URL and rendered page must match the approved semantic intent.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify the filter action and direct source URL across approved and unapproved states.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only the screenshot example is fixed while other approved location and feature pages still remain query URLs.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Remove the single accommodation type restriction in the shared approved-intent resolver.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: No-type approved feature pages and type-specific approved feature pages both resolve through the same canonical registry.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Dates, guests, price or sort are redirected and the active search state is lost.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep transactional search state outside the SEO redirect path.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Dated and priced searches retain their exact query parameters and do not redirect to a static landing.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The clean page exists but lacks metadata, content, FAQ, self canonical or sitemap membership.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Publish the curated page through the existing managed search page model.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The page passes publication quality rules and is returned by the search-pages sitemap inventory.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Non-Hebrew routes are silently redirected to an unapproved Hebrew edition.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Apply the server redirect only to the approved Hebrew locale.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The route guard requires the Hebrew locale before issuing a permanent redirect.

sources.label: VII search page URL and publication policy
Existing type plus feature canonical tests

midpoint_gate.trigger: The shared resolver recognizes approved no-type semantic filters.
checks: צפון with pool resolves to the new approved path
an existing no-type approved feature page resolves without a new special case
transactional state remains on the operational URL

attack_questions: Can the source URL redirect in a loop?
Can a dated search lose its dates?
Can an unapproved combination be indexed accidentally?
Can the clean page be omitted from the sitemap?
Can a localized route be redirected to the wrong language?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Focused resolver tests, production build and rendered local route verification.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: No-type, type-specific, transactional, unknown and localized route tests.

effectiveness.baseline: The public URL /vacations/north?pool=1 stays parameterized and presents the generic north landing.
effectiveness.target: Approved semantic filter URLs resolve to one clean page with complete publication data while transactional and unapproved filters remain operational URLs.
